title: Bound-Relaxed 36-Layer DBR with Gradient Optimization
scientific_hypothesis: Expanding thickness bounds from 20-350 nm to 20-355 nm will increase valid candidate diversity by providing additional search space near the upper bound, without altering the underlying dual-band suppression physics of the quarter-wave stack topology.
design_principle: Quarter-wave stack initialization at 355 nm center wavelength with gradient-based thickness optimization across all 36 layers to balance dual stopband suppression and visible passband transmission.
proposed_topology: 36 finite layers: alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 starting with Ta2O5 at air interface, ending with SiO2 at substrate interface (18 high-index layers, 18 low-index layers)
manufacturing_considerations: 5 nm bound relaxation may require deposition system recalibration
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for high-reflection bands
expected_advantages: Increased valid_candidates count compared to route_01
Improved numerical convergence due to expanded feasible region
known_risks: Bound relaxation may not resolve convergence if issue is algorithmic rather than constraint-related
Upper thickness limit approaching may cause stress issues in fabrication
execution_request_english: Optimize a 36-layer alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate at 0 degree incidence, unpolarized light. Layer sequence: Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2 (36 layers total). Thickness bounds: 20-355 nm per layer. Initialize with quarter-wave optical thickness at 355 nm center wavelength. Optimize all 36 thicknesses using gradient-based optimizer to maximize average transmittance in 420-700 nm band while minimizing average transmittance in 355-365 nm and 1030-1080 nm bands, and minimizing transmittance at 355 nm. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates count, tightest_margin, and final thicknesses_nm array. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 355-355 nm, 355-365 nm, 420-700 nm, 1030-1080 nm. soft objectives: high average transmittance in 420-700 nm; low average transmittance at 355 nm; low average transmittance in 355-365 nm; low average transmittance in 1030-1080 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high transmittance at 355 nm; high transmittance in 355-365 nm; high transmittance in 1030-1080 nm; high loss in 420-700 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 36 layers; layer thickness range 20-350 nm.
revision_reason: Bound relaxation from 350 nm to 355 nm per feedback directive to address low valid_candidate count (4 candidates in route_01). Same 36-layer topology but expanded search space.
